data.one_liner: Firebase UI widgets for authentication and OAuth providers.
data.what_it_does: Provides base UI widgets and providers for authenticating users via various OAuth services in Firebase applications. It acts as a foundation for specific OAuth provider packages like Apple, Google, Facebook, and Twitter.
use_when: Building a Flutter app backed by Firebase Authentication
Needing pre-built UI components and providers for OAuth sign-in flows
avoid_when: Not using Firebase Authentication as your backend
Building a custom-designed authentication UI from scratch without Firebase
strengths: Simplifies integration with multiple OAuth providers through Firebase
Provides ready-to-use UI elements for authentication
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to Firebase and Firebase Auth
Relies on additional provider-specific subpackages for complete functionality
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Firebase in your project and installing appropriate provider-specific subpackages (Apple, Google, Facebook, Twitter).

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to handle authentication logic and API calls manually without using the pre-built Firebase UI components.

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need Google Sign-In and prefer a direct SDK integration rather than using Firebase UI.
